items.text: One-time feature balloons (desktop) — contextual Got it promos appear beside the relevant control the first time you use a feature; stored in localStorage per promo kind. Hidden on mobile and during onboarding, tours, or other overlays.
Shared left/right placement — DashboardPromoPlacement.positionBesideAnchor() picks the side with more viewport space and vertically centers the balloon (arrow points at the anchor).

Search promos — > (search), : (commands), and ? (finders) each get their own promo beside the search bar; a follow-up filters promo appears after you dismiss the search promo and first type tag:, category:, status:, page:, or @.

Grid & collections — first arrow-key selection shows a grid-navigation promo beside the bookmark row; first G+1–9 or GG jump shows a separate G-jump promo; first jump into a smart collection shows a promo beside the category header.

Feature promos — inline edit (;), tag cloud (/), tag-filter bulk toolbar, recent bookmarks (*), preview card ([), quick-add omnibox (&), week overview (header date click), category collapse (Enter/Space on header), quick move (Shift+M), quick delete (Shift+D), page overview (,), and keyboard cheat sheet (!/F1).
Config settings search promo — the breadcrumb search balloon uses the same left/right beside-anchor placement as dashboard promos (repositions on scroll/resize).

Promo coordination — promos defer while search, modals, tours, or another promo is open; closing a host overlay dismisses its promo without marking it seen (including Esc on quick-move/delete popovers); filter and bulk promos can retry after a short delay when the tag cloud is still open.
Cheat sheet promo layering — the !/F1 balloon renders above the modal overlay so Got it dismisses only the promo, not the cheat sheet.

Promo replay controls — Reset G+jump promo and Reset cheat sheet promo in config → Advanced → System & tools → Tours & onboarding (desktop). Cheat-sheet reset opens the sheet when the dashboard tab is active.

Shift+D quick delete — with a bookmark row selected, opens the same popover UI as Shift+M: choose Delete or Cancel with arrows and Enter; undo remains in the toast. Plain Delete still opens the confirmation dialog.
Move/delete popovers beside the row — Shift+M, Shift+D, and tag-filter bulk move menus use the shared beside-anchor placement and reposition on scroll/resize.
Move popover context — shows the bookmark’s current category (or categories) above the destination list.

Bulk toolbar on filtered grid — when a tag filter has matches, a toolbar under the filter chips offers Open all / Open first N, Copy links, Move (category or page popover), and Delete (confirm + undo toast).
Bulk discoverability promo — one-time balloon beside the toolbar after the tag-cloud promo was dismissed and matches exist.
Tag cloud positioning — modal sizes from tag count, prefers above or below the / FAB based on space, and scrolls the body when content exceeds the column.
Filter chips only — removed the redundant FAB badge text; active filters stay on the header chips and filter summary tooltip.

Week overview theming — the date popover uses dashboard theme tokens (--background-secondary, --border-primary, --accent-primary) instead of hardcoded dark-glass fallbacks; modern and glass layouts get matching elevation.

Preview cards spotlight — after What’s new, layout-versions, and paste-URL hints, desktop users who still have preview cards off may see a one-time bottom stripe with Enable or Never mind. It waits until onboarding, tours, modals, and other promos are idle. Reset from config → Advanced → System & tools → Tours & onboarding.
Cheat sheet & config Help — Shift+D quick delete documented in the keyboard cheat sheet and Help → Keyboard / Navigation (EN/NL/DE/FR).
Rotating tips — tipQuickDelete and tipQuickMove added to the dashboard tip rotation.
AppModal structure repair — ensureModalStructure() rebuilds missing header/body on an existing #app-modal so recent-bookmarks and other modals render reliably.
README & manual — desktop discoverability overview (G+jump, cheat sheet, settings-search promo); Tours & onboarding lists the new promo reset buttons.
